touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Allington qualifies as a local detour through Allington village cross and CHURCH OF THE HOLY TRINITY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Allington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Allington offers Allington village cross, CHURCH OF THE HOLY TRINITY, CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Allington village cross
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Allington village cross and CHURCH OF THE HOLY TRINITY, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
